vetSays.line: 🛡️ Carolina, Colton, Rebecca and the person in their 60s, with a crooked nose met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Carolina, Colton, Rebecca, the person in their 60s, with a crooked nose are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Carolina, Colton and Pilipus met them at the door — 3 put down. Carolina, Colton, Pilipus are hurt.

regDeaths.name: something huge, rooting in the underbrush
a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong
a red moon rising between the trees, breathing
